add.title: Add user
add.description: Enter their work email. Everything else — name, department, business unit, legal entity, manager — comes from Google Workspace and stays in sync with it.
add.synced: Added, with their profile from Google Workspace ({email}).
add.aliasOfExisting: That address is an alias of {email}, who is already here. Their profile was refreshed instead.
add.notInDirectory: Added. Google Workspace has no account for that address yet, so only the email is on file — the daily directory sync will fill in the rest once it appears.
add.directoryOff: Added with the email only: the Google Workspace directory is not enabled in this environment. Their profile fills in on first sign-in.
add.existsDeactivated: {name} is already in the directory, deactivated. Reactivate them rather than adding them again.

sync.badgeTitle: NetSuite disagrees on {count, plural, one {# field} other {# fields}} — see People ↔ NetSuite
sync.explain: NetSuite holds a different value for these fields. ExpenseOS follows ADP through Google and never overwrites either; a reviewer rules which system is right.
sync.hrItHelp: Adopted from NetSuite while Google still says otherwise — HR or IT need to correct the upstream record.
sync.editNotice: NetSuite disagrees about: {fields}. Changing these here does not settle it.
